svg.title: Measuring an angle in radians
svg.desc: A radius sweeps a full circle while the arc it traces is laid out straight and measured in radius lengths; a full turn is 2 pi, about 6.28 radians. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: An angle in radians counts radius lengths of arc
Arc length Δs laid out straight
One radian is the angle whose arc equals the radius. A full turn fits 2π ≈ 6.28 radius lengths, so
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
